questions.subject: english

teaching.kind: 列車時刻表：分清行駛日、到站時刻與行車時間
knowledge: 時刻表雙重檢核：行駛日（Operation Days）＋各站時刻
統測圖表題看火車／高鐵時刻表時，除了看各站發車與抵達時間外，第一欄「行駛日（Daily 每日行駛 vs 特定星期如 Mon–Fri / Sun）」與「過站不停（—）」是必考關鍵！
steps: 題目問 NOT true。先定位車次所在列，再找對應站名欄位，不能串錯列。
606 的行駛日確實是 Sat，星期六不是錯誤所在；桃園到站時刻為 08:38，並非 C 寫的 08:30，差了 8 分鐘。
204 的板橋、台北分別有 08:27、08:37，故 D 正確。只有 C 的到站時刻不符，選 C。
reasons: 802 的 Operation Day 為 Daily，表示每日行駛，A 正確。
606 週六有行駛，但桃園是 08:38，不是 08:30；錯在時刻而非星期。
204 在板橋 08:27、台北 08:37 都有時刻，表示兩站均停靠。

transfer.prompt: 閱讀英文時刻表時，若某站欄位畫一條橫線「—」代表什麼意思？
transfer.answer: 代表該班列車「過站不停（Does not stop at this station）」。
steps: 時刻表中數字代表到開時刻。
橫線「—」表示列車直接通過該站不停靠。
做題時若旅客要在此站上下車，必須排除畫「—」的班次。

teaching.kind: 時刻表選車：星期、停靠站與到達期限取交集
knowledge: 三個必要條件缺一不可
必須週六行駛、在新竹停靠讓 Denny 上車，並在 08:50 前到台北。先排除不行駛或不停靠者，再比較到站時間；不能只挑最快的一班。
steps: 題目限定 Saturday、新竹上車，以及台北 08:50 見面。
1202、1602 都標 Mon ~ Fri，週六不行駛，排除 B、C；1202 的新竹欄也為 —。
606 週六行駛且新竹停靠，但台北 09:02，晚於 08:50，排除 D。
802 每日行駛、新竹 07:58、台北 08:32，可提前 18 分鐘到達，選 A。
reasons: 802 同時符合週六、停靠新竹、08:50 前到台北三條件。
1202 只在週一至週五行駛，而且新竹不停靠。
1602 雖停新竹且台北 08:42，但週六不行駛。
606 台北 09:02，已比約定時間晚 12 分鐘。

transfer.prompt: 沿用原表，若同樣週六、新竹上車，但見面改為 09:10，802 與 606 是否都能在期限前到台北？
transfer.answer: 兩班都可以，分別於 08:32、09:02 到台北。
steps: 兩班週六都有行駛並停新竹。
條件改變後合格集合可能增加，不可只背原題選 A。

teaching.kind: 活動海報：以玩法判斷團隊運動
knowledge: team sport 要回到定義欄
原海報的 Basketball 與 Rugby 皆以 Two teams score points 描述，明確是兩隊競賽。Badminton 的 Two or four people 不等於每一種情形都是團隊賽，不能只看人數大於一就下結論。
steps: 題目要找 team sport，不是要找特定時段。
掃讀 HOW TO PLAY 欄，Basketball 和 Rugby 都明寫 Two teams。
Cycling、Swimming、Weightlifting 用 An individual 描述；其餘選項至少包含個人項目。
兩個項目都符合的組合為 Rugby and basketball，選 D。
reasons: Basketball 符合，但 Weightlifting 在表中以個人活動描述。
Cycling 在表中由個人騎車，不能組成兩個團隊項目。
Swimming 在表中由個人活動，不符合兩項都為團隊運動。
Rugby 與 Basketball 的玩法欄均寫 Two teams，證據完整。

transfer.prompt: 原創海報寫甲「An individual runs」，乙「Two teams pass a ball」。只依海報，哪一項可直接判為團隊項目？
steps: 定位玩法欄，不看場地或費用。
An individual 指個人，Two teams 指兩隊。
乙有直接文字證據，甲沒有。

teaching.kind: 旅館比較表：先選景點列，再取較短距離
knowledge: 不要混用相鄰景點的數字
兩間旅館都列了三個景點距離，必須先找 Theme Park，再比較 6 km、16 km。2 km 與 8 km 是 Art Museum 的距離，不能因為更小就拿來回答主題樂園。
steps: 題目問離 Theme Park 較近的旅館，到該景點要開多遠。

questions.passage: Jensen Huang ( 黃仁勳) is the chief executive of NVIDIA, a leading company that makes chips used in artificial intelligence ( AI ). In 2023, Huang was listed among the 100 most influential people in AI. An inspiration to many, Huang encourages young people to seize the opportunities that AI will present. Meanwhile, he reminds them to take a positive attitude towards challenges. In a speech to university graduates in Taiwan last year, Huang shared two important lessons he has learned in the past three decades. The first lesson is not to be discouraged by failure. In 1996, his company nearly closed down due to rapid changes in the industry. They soon realized that they had made a mistake, and Huang humbly asked a major customer for help. With the customer’s support, the company moved on to invent the chip that led to their future success. Huang’s advice is to always honestly face your mistakes and seek help. The second lesson is to keep going despite difficulties. In 2007, the company made an expensive investment on product improvements. The new products were not selling well for many years until they started being used for machine learning. The experience taught Huang and his colleagues to handle the pain and suffering needed to achieve their vision. Their continued efforts help build NVIDIA into a global leader in AI technologies. Huang’s life story is also about pushing oneself to do better. Born in Taiwan, Huang moved to the United States at the age of nine. He later earned two engineering degrees before working for two chip companies. In 1993, on his 30th birthday, he and two friends founded NVIDIA. Today, Huang often advises students to live a life of purpose, and to run, not walk, towards their goals.

questions.groupTitle: 閱讀下文,回答第 39-42 題
questions.passage: On October 9, 2023, Triton, the fi rst weather satellite made in Taiwan successfully entered space. It is also the fourth satellite in the world to use GNSS-R instrument to collect weather data. Its purpose is to help us predict the weather more accurately. This satellite is named after Triton, an ancient Greek god of t he sea. The sea god commands the wind and waves. The satellite Triton is able to gather such data as wave heights and sea wind speeds. Triton uses a technique that collects signals reflected from the Earth’s surface. It carries GNSS-R instrument to receive signals which are sent back from sea surfaces. The calmer the sea, the stronger the signal, indicating weaker winds. This information is valuable as wind speed data is not easy to collect. Such information improves the prediction of typhoon strengths and movements. Triton observes weather changes mainly in the Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, and central Pacific Ocean. Triton, started in 2014, is the fruitful cooperation between Taiwan Space Agency (TASA) and local companies. TASA developed GNSS-R instrument and key components such as the Onboard Computer and GPS Receiver. More than 20 local research groups and manufacturers participated in developing the ground station equipment. The satellite is 82% developed and produced in Taiwan. Now that Triton is in space, we can expect it to provide more a ccurate information and support disaster prevention. The success of Triton contributes to global weather forecasting. It is also an important step forward for Taiwan’s space engineering. Triton: 獵風者氣象衛星 TASA: Taiwan Space Agency 國家太空中心 GNSS-R: Global Navigation Satellite System-Reflectometry 全球導航衛星系統反射訊號接 收儀
